task.description: Update CHANGELOG.md for this WF-03 run (ISS-0176/GH-504, PR #588). UNLIKE other runs today, this one DOES have a requirement to update: LUA-07 (MUST priority, currently IN_PROGRESS) should now be set to RELEASED, since both of its acceptance criteria are satisfied (criterion 1 was already done per ISS-0169; criterion 2 -- manifest_hash in the execution audit record -- is what this run closes). Run: python3 tools/reqctl.py set-status LUA-07 RELEASED --implemented-in src/engine/lua_script_audit.zig migrations/095_iss0176_lua_script_execution_audit.sql tests/integration/iss0176_lua07_audit_manifest_hash_test.zig -- then python3 tools/reqctl.py render-status to regenerate docs/status/requirement_status.yaml. IMPORTANT CAVEAT to record in the changelog and/or requirement notes: this criterion is satisfied via a deliberately minimal, human-operator-confirmed synthetic wiring path (executeScriptForAudit), NOT via the full SERVICE_TASK-with-script engine integration, which remains unbuilt (future roadmap item per src/design/lua-integration.md section 25). Do not let this be misread as 'scripts can now run as part of normal process execution' -- they cannot yet. No estimation.json exists for this run -- skip retrospective. Note: another workspace (r-co-1-loop) may push to main concurrently -- rebase if needed, resolve any orchestrator.log conflict by keeping both sides chronologically. Then perform Step Final: confirm PR #588 CI green, squash-merge, delete branch, update board for issue #504, return to clean main.
